title: CFBrainAug: Modularity-Induced Counterfactual Brain Network Augmentation for Interpretable fMRI-based Autism Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.32184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning on resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) brain networks is promising for diagnosing Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), but existing methods are prone to overfitting on limited training data, and their post-hoc statistical attribution offers limited clinical interpretability. We propose CFBrainAug, a counterfactual brain network learning framework that unifies data augmentation and counterfactual explanation by learning label-altered brain networks. Unlike conventional label-preserving augmentation, CFBrainAug first retrieves a label-opposite yet topologically similar candidate and then refines it under a module-number constraint. Jointly training on factual and counterfactual networks enriches the training distribution around the decision boundary, enabling a lightweight feature-selection-based SVM to perform competitively with recent graph deep learning methods. translated_abstract: 在静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）脑网络上进行机器学习对于诊断自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）具有广阔前景，但现有方法容易在有限的训练数据上过拟合，且其事后统计归因提供的临床可解释性有限。我们提出了CFBrainAug，这是一个反事实脑网络学习框架，通过学习标签改变的脑网络，将数据增强与反事实解释统一起来。与传统的标签保持增强不同，CFBrainAug首先检索一个标签相反但拓扑相似的候选网络，然后在模块数量约束下对其进行细化。在事实网络与反事实网络上进行联合训练，丰富了决策边界附近的训练分布，使得基于轻量级特征选择的SVM能够与近期的图深度学习方法相媲美。同时，反事实网络提供了（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了反事实脑网络学习框架CFBrainAug，通过生成标签相反但拓扑相似、并受模块数量约束的脑网络来统一数据增强与反事实解释，在提升基于fMRI自闭症诊断性能的同时增强了临床可解释性。
en_tdlr: CFBrainAug is a counterfactual brain network learning framework that unifies data augmentation and counterfactual explanation by generating label-altered, modularity-constrained brain networks, improving interpretable fMRI-based autism diagnosis with a lightweight SVM competitive with graph deep learning methods.
